title: [SV+] Harvester VM Contention
description: Where are VMs being starved? CPU run-queue delay (vSphere CPU Ready analogue), guest and host memory pressure, storage latency and network drops. Harvester 1.8.x / KubeVirt 1.7.x.

panels.title: Overview: is anything being starved right now?
VMs: CPU Ready > 5%
panels.description: VMs whose vCPUs spend more than 5% of the time runnable but not scheduled. vSphere guidance: >5% per vCPU is a warning, >10% is a problem.

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}))) > 5) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst CPU Ready
panels.description: Highest CPU Ready % of any VM in the selection.

targets.expr: max(100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: VMs: guest mem > 90%
panels.description: VMs whose guest OS reports less than 10% memory available (MemAvailable, so page cache is NOT counted as used). Needs qemu-guest-agent.

targets.expr: count((100 * (1 - max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_usable_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}) / max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_available_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}))) > 90) or vector(0)

panels.title: Max VM memory PSI
panels.description: Highest share of the last 5 minutes in which a VM's launcher cgroup stalled waiting for memory (kernel PSI via cAdvisor). Any sustained value means the VM is being reclaimed or is thrashing on the host.

targets.expr: max(label_replace(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])), "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: Max VM CPU PSI
panels.description: Highest share of the last 5 minutes in which a VM's launcher cgroup waited for a CPU (PSI via cAdvisor): CPU limit throttling plus run-queue wait.

targets.expr: max(label_replace(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])), "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: OOM kills (1h)
panels.description: Kernel OOM kills on the nodes (any process, including pods killed at their memory limit) plus OOM events of virt-launcher compute containers in the last hour. A launcher OOM kill takes the VM down.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill[1h]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})) + (sum(increase(container_oom_events_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[1h])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: VMs near memory limit
panels.description: VMs whose virt-launcher working set is above 90% of its memory limit: OOM-kill risk for the VM.

targets.expr: count((label_replace(100 * container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"} / on (namespace, pod, container) kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}, "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}")) > 90) or vector(0)

panels.title: VMs throttled > 5%
panels.description: VMs whose launcher hit its CPU limit in more than 5% of scheduling periods.

targets.expr: count((label_replace(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])), "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}")) > 5) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU Ready % per VM (top N)
panels.description: Time vCPUs spent runnable but waiting for a physical CPU, as % of wall time, averaged over the VM's vCPUs (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total). Equivalent of vSphere CPU Ready %. Needs kernel schedstats; no series means the node does not expose it.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: CPU usage % of allocated vCPUs (top N)
panels.description: Guest + hypervisor CPU time as % of the VM's vCPUs (kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total). Read together with CPU Ready: high ready with low usage means the host, not the guest, is the bottleneck.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: vCPU I/O wait per VM (top N)
panels.description: Time vCPUs spent blocked waiting on I/O, per vCPU (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_wait_seconds_total). Not CPU steal: this points at storage.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_wait_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: VM CPU pressure (PSI, top N)
panels.description: % of time the VM's launcher cgroup waited for CPU (container_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total). Complements CPU Ready with the host-cgroup view.

targets.expr: topk($topn, label_replace(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])), "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: Host CPU pressure (PSI) per node [needs kernel PSI]
panels.description: Kernel pressure-stall information: % of time tasks waited for CPU. Empty for nodes whose kernel boots without PSI (psi=1).

targets.expr: 100 * rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: virt-launcher CFS throttling (top N)
panels.description: % of scheduling periods in which the VM's launcher container hit its CPU limit and was throttled. Relevant when CPU overcommit sets limits.

targets.expr: topk($topn, label_replace(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])), "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: Guest memory in use % (top N)
panels.description: 100 * (1 - MemAvailable / total), from the guest agent. Unlike the stock Harvester panel (available - unused) this does not count reclaimable page cache as used. Closest to vSphere 'Active' memory.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 100 * (1 - max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_usable_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}) / max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_available_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Guest swap activity (top N)
panels.description: Change of the guest's swap-in + swap-out counters over 5 minutes (kubevirt_vmi_memory_swap_*_traffic_bytes are gauges). Any sustained value means the guest is short of memory. Equivalent of vSphere 'Swapped' but measured inside the guest.

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (namespace, name) (clamp_min(delta(kubevirt_vmi_memory_swap_in_traffic_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m]), 0)) + sum by (namespace, name) (clamp_min(delta(kubevirt_vmi_memory_swap_out_traffic_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m]), 0)))

panels.title: Guest major page faults/s (top N)
panels.description: Page faults that needed disk I/O (kubevirt_vmi_memory_pgmajfault_total). Rising values mean the guest is thrashing.

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_memory_pgmajfault_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])))

panels.title: Memory balloon (non-zero VMs)
panels.description: Balloon size per VM (kubevirt_vmi_memory_actual_balloon_bytes). Harvester does not reclaim through the balloon by default, so empty is normal; vSphere 'Ballooned' has no routine equivalent here.

targets.expr: kubevirt_vmi_memory_actual_balloon_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"} > 0

panels.title: virt-launcher memory vs limit % (top N)
panels.description: Working set of the VM's launcher container as % of its memory limit. Near 100% means the launcher (guest RAM + QEMU overhead) is about to be OOM-killed.

targets.expr: topk($topn, label_replace(100 * container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"} / on (namespace, pod, container) kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}, "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: VM memory pressure (PSI, top N)
panels.description: % of time the VM's launcher cgroup stalled on memory: 'some' (waiting) per VM. Host-side memory contention as seen by each VM (cAdvisor; needs PSI on the node the VM runs on).

targets.expr: topk($topn, label_replace(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])), "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: Host memory available %
panels.description: MemAvailable / MemTotal per node.

targets.expr: (100 * node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Host memory pressure (PSI) per node [needs kernel PSI]
panels.description: 'some': at least one task waited for memory; 'full': all non-idle tasks stalled. This is the host-side memory contention signal.

targets.expr: 100 * rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
100 * rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Host major faults/s and OOM kills
panels.description: node_vmstat_pgmajfault rate and OOM kills per node.

targets.expr: rate(node_vmstat_pgmajfault[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Read latency per VM disk (top N)
panels.description: Average time per read I/O: rate(read_times_seconds) / rate(iops_read). Equivalent of vSphere virtual-disk read latency.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 1000 * rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_read_times_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m]) / (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_read_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m]) > 0))

panels.title: Write latency per VM disk (top N)
panels.description: Average time per write I/O. Compare with Longhorn volume latency to see which layer is slow.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 1000 * rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_write_times_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m]) / (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_write_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m]) > 0))

panels.title: VM I/O pressure (PSI, top N)
panels.description: % of time the VM's launcher cgroup waited for block I/O.

targets.expr: topk($topn, label_replace(100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",container="compute",pod=~"virt-launcher-$vm-[a-z0-9]{5}"}[5m])), "name", "$1", "pod", "virt-launcher-(.*)-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

panels.title: Host I/O pressure (PSI) per node [needs kernel PSI]
panels.description: % of time tasks waited for block I/O on the node.

targets.expr: 100 * rate(node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})
100 * rate(node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total[5m]) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node"})

panels.title: Network drops/s per VM (top N)
panels.description: vNIC rx + tx dropped packets.

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_network_receive_packets_dropped_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])) + sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_network_transmit_packets_dropped_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])))

panels.title: Network errors/s per VM (top N)
panels.description: vNIC rx + tx errors.

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_network_receive_errors_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])) + sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_network_transmit_errors_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm",node=~"$node"}[5m])))
